firm_data.firm_description: Kreindler & Kreindler LLP is a leading law firm representing plaintiffs from around the United States and the world. Since 1950, Kreindler & Kreindler LLP has earned its reputation as the premier aviation accident litigation law firm representing plaintiffs.

email.subject: AI for Kreindler & Kreindler, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Vaneat,

Kreindler's reputation in aviation accident litigation since 1950 is built on precision and client trust. Managing complex multi-jurisdictional cases for plaintiffs worldwide requires tools that match your firm's standards, not compromise them.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of specialized practices: accuracy, client confidence, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now expanding our footprint. I'd be happy to stop by your New York office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw on their terms.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
